पयोग्रहसमर्थनप्रकार mīm. on the substitution of milk
for intoxicating spirits in the Vājapeya ceremony, by
Vāsudeva, son of Prabhākara Bhaṭṭa. Hall p. 192.

पायिनीमाहात्म्य (near Pāḷāṃkoṭṭā on the Malabar coast)
from the Puṣkarakhaṇḍa of the Padmapurāṇa (?).
पायगुण्ड a surname. See Bālakṛṣṇa and Vaidyanātha
